title: 极小的 bigram 语言模型训练若干步（损失下降）
expected_output:
字符表 V: 12  字符集: abehinoqrstu
初始损失: 2.4849
最终损失: 0.8651
损失下降: True
单调下降步占比: 1.0
训练后对 t 的最高概率下一字符: o
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
text = "tobeornottobethatisthequestiontobeornottobe"
chars = sorted(set(text))
stoi = {c: i for i, c in enumerate(chars)}
itos = {i: c for i, c in enumerate(chars)}
V = len(chars)
data = np.array([stoi[c] for c in text], dtype=int)
W = np.zeros((V, V))
def loss_fn(W):
    ls = 0.0
    for t in range(len(data) - 1):
        i = data[t]; j = data[t + 1]
        z = W[i]; z = z - z.max()
        p = np.exp(z); p = p / p.sum()
        ls += -np.log(p[j] + 1e-12)
    return ls / (len(data) - 1)
lr = 0.3
losses = [loss_fn(W)]
for step in range(300):
    g = np.zeros_like(W)
    for t in range(len(data) - 1):
        i = data[t]; j = data[t + 1]
        z = W[i]; z = z - z.max()
        p = np.exp(z); p = p / p.sum()
        g[i, j] -= 1.0
        g[i] += p
    W -= lr * g
    losses.append(loss_fn(W))
l0 = losses[0]; lf = losses[-1]
print("字符表 V:", V, " 字符集:", "".join(chars))
print("初始损失:", round(l0, 4))
print("最终损失:", round(lf, 4))
print("损失下降:", bool(lf < l0))
print("单调下降步占比:", round(sum(1 for a, b in zip(losses, losses[1:]) if b < a) / (len(losses) - 1), 3))
print("训练后对 t 的最高概率下一字符:", itos[int(np.argmax(W[stoi["t"]]))])
